description: Implementation of the BufferPool class for managing Metal GPU buffers in ANGLE's renderer, including buffer allocation, deallocation, and management functions.

classes.name: BufferPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of Metal buffers for efficient GPU resource management.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the buffer pool with specified size, alignment, and maximum buffers.

methods.name: allocateNewBuffer
methods.description: Allocates a new buffer, reusing free buffers if possible.

methods.name: allocate
methods.description: Allocates a segment within the buffer pool for use, mapping it if requested.

methods.name: commit
methods.description: Finalizes current buffer allocations and prepares buffers for GPU use.

methods.name: releaseInFlightBuffers
methods.description: Releases buffers that are no longer in use by the GPU.

methods.name: destroyBufferList
methods.description: Clears a list of buffers and updates allocation counts.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Destroys all buffers and resets the pool.

methods.name: updateAlignment
methods.description: Updates the memory alignment for buffer allocations.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets internal state of the buffer pool.
